department: Division of Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, and Computer Science

deadline.value: International application deadline for Fall 2027 entry is March 15, 2027; general/domestic Fall admission deadline is April 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Application Deadline: Fall – April 15 International Application Deadline: Fall – March 15

gre_subject.value: Neither the department page nor the 2026-2027 Graduate Catalog states whether a GRE Subject Test (Mathematics or Physics) is required or optional.

supervisor.value: Prior supervisor agreement is not stated; incoming students develop a course of study in consultation with the Director of Graduate Programs.

funding.value: Graduate research or teaching assistantships and fellowships are available competitively through the Applied Mathematics Research Center or the Division.
funding.quote: Graduate research or teaching assistantships and fellowships are available.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter directly with a bachelor's degree (72 total credits, completing an MS en route) or with a master's degree (39 PhD-level credits).
entry_route.quote: A student who enters the program with a baccalaureate degree must complete his or her master’s degree before his or her Ph.D. study, so he or she must complete 72 credit hours of graduate-level credits (33 credits at MS level and 39 credits at Ph.D. level). Students who have master’s degrees with no prior Ph.D. graduate coursework must complete 30 credit hours of graduate-level courses listed below.

notes: Offers concentrations in Applied Mathematics and Mathematical Physics. Requires minimum 2.50 overall GPA and 3.0 GPA in field-related coursework, GRE General scores, resume, and three letters of recommendation.
name: Ph.D. in Interdisciplinary Applied Mathematics and Mathematical Physics
